record.original_question: Let K be a semi-Eberlein compact space. Is there a homeomorphic embedding φ:K→[-1,1]^Γ such that the finitely supported points φ(K)∩c₀₀(Γ) are dense in φ(K)? In particular, does this hold when K is scattered, when K is Eberlein or uniform Eberlein, when K is the specific compact space constructed in Theorem 4.7, or when K is the dual ball of a Banach space?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.6. Let K be a semi-Eberlein compactum. Is there a homeomorphic embedding φ: K → [−1, 1]Γ such that φ(K) ∩ c00(Γ) is dense in φ(K)? In particular, is the property true in the following cases? (1) K is scattered; (2) K is actually Eberlein, or even uniform Eberlein; (3) in particular, K is the compactum constructed in [50], see Theorem 4.7; (4) K is the dual ball of a Banach space.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A compact Hausdorff space $K$ is called semi-Eberlein if there exists a set $\Gamma$ and a homeomorphic embedding $\psi : K \to [-1,1]^\Gamma$ such that the set $\psi(K) \cap c_{00}(\Gamma)$ is dense in $\psi(K)$, where 
$$c_{00}(\Gamma) := \{x \in \mathbb{R}^\Gamma : \{\gamma \in \Gamma : x(\gamma) \neq 0\}\text{ is finite}\}.$$
A compact space $K$ is Eberlein if it is homeomorphic to a weakly compact subset of a Banach space, equivalently, if it admits an embedding into $c_0(\Gamma) = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^\Gamma : \{\gamma : |x(\gamma)| > \varepsilon\}\text{ is finite for every }\varepsilon > 0\}$ (with the product topology). It is uniform Eberlein if it embeds into a Hilbert space with the weak topology. $K$ is scattered if every nonempty closed subset has an isolated point.

Question: Let $K$ be a semi-Eberlein compactum. Does there always exist a homeomorphic embedding $\varphi : K \to [-1,1]^\Gamma$ (for some index set $\Gamma$) such that 
$$\varphi(K) \cap c_{00}(\Gamma)\text{ is dense in }\varphi(K)?$$
In particular, does such an embedding exist in each of the following cases:
(1) $K$ is scattered;
(2) $K$ is Eberlein, or uniform Eberlein;
(3) $K$ is the dual unit ball (in the weak* topology) of a Banach space whose dual unit ball is a semi-Eberlein compactum?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a 2024 survey on norming Markushevich bases. A direct web search did not turn up any subsequent paper resolving the question for general semi-Eberlein compacta, so the problem appears to remain open.
